proposal.critical_boundary: PHP Supplier detail labels order.cost + pay_postage as actual income/settlement; TS checkout writes order.cost as procurement cost. These field names are not semantically interchangeable.
proposal.ts_order_cost: SUM((activitySku.cost ?? sku.cost) * actual quantity), written to store_order.cost; frozen JSON costPrice also separate.
proposal.supplier_settlement_authority: store_order_cart_info.settle_price * actual cart_num; SupplierFinanceService adds postage except shipping_type2/4 and uses this value for actual payment flowing-water rows.
proposal.retail_authority_distinct: Picking-sheet and export unit price are customer retail/paid promotion evidence; never relabel them Supplier settlement.
proposal.suggested_display: Show frozen settlement unit/subtotal and actual postage separately. Any computed combined value must state 冻结结算参考（不代表已到账）. Showing actual ledger status or balance would require a separate correctly authorized ledger read, not an inference from paid/status.
proposal.legacy_question: A default 0.00 settlement column alone cannot prove whether an old row had a known zero price or was never populated. Agree an explicit legacy availability/zero policy before presenting a total; never silently fall back to current SKU or procurement cost.
proposal.quantity_boundary: Actual row cart_num is authoritative after splits/refunds; PHP tidyOrder explicitly replaces JSON cart_num. Picking/export have a mature legacy-zero fallback; do not copy it blindly into a new detail contract without verifying generation semantics.

amount_authority.source: Actual line settle_price and actual cart_num. Historic positive values may have been migration-backfilled from then-current product; no claim of original frozen provenance. Never substitute cost, retail or current SKU.
amount_authority.zero_policy: Modern checkout/refund row0 without legacy_php_financial_source is recorded0; otherwise explicit historic attr0 is required. Unknown historic0, legacy-marked refund descendants without attr0 and empty lines are incomplete.
amount_authority.postage: Excluded for shipping_type2/4; actual customer postage is separately displayed.
